# Sonnet

> Sonnet is a free, open-source (AGPL-3.0), self-hosted library and reader for ebooks, audiobooks, PDFs and manga. A server on your own computer or home server holds the files; you read and listen in a browser or in the Sonnet desktop app for Windows and macOS.

Key facts:

- Formats read in the browser: EPUB, PDF, CBZ, TXT. Audiobooks: M4B, MP3, M4A, FLAC, OGG, Opus, WAV.
- Reader: paged or scrolling, right-to-left for manga, dark, dusk, sepia and light pages, seven typefaces, lighting sliders (light, warmth, grain, contrast), bookmarks, highlights in four colours, notes, search, table of contents.
- Reading goals, streaks and stats; up to 8 profiles per sign-in; families that share shelves and reviews.
- Can be used without an account: a guest tied to one browser, with a copy of its reading kept in the browser and optionally in a local folder.
- Offline: installs to a phone's home screen over HTTPS and keeps chosen books on the device.
- Install: desktop apps (Windows, macOS), Docker, or Node 24. One SQLite file; no API keys.
- Not included: native phone apps, OPDS, e-reader sync, MOBI/AZW3/CBR, LDAP or single sign-on.
- Similar projects: Kavita, Komga, Audiobookshelf, Calibre-Web.
